"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/sequential-digits/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1291. Sequential Digits

An integer has sequential digits if and only if each digit in the number is one more than the previous digit.

Return a sorted list of all the integers in the range [low, high] inclusive that have sequential digits.

Example 1:

Input: low = 100, high = 300
Output: [123,234]

Example 2:

Input: low = 1000, high = 13000
Output: [1234,2345,3456,4567,5678,6789,12345]

Constraints:

    10 <= low <= high <= 10^9
"""


class Solution:
    def sequentialDigits(self, low: int, high: int) -> List[int]:
        result = []
        digits = "123456789"
        n_low = len(str(low))
        n_high = len(str(high))
        for length in range(n_low, n_high + 1):
            for start in range(0, 10 - length):
                num = int(digits[start : start + length])
                if low <= num <= high:
                    result.append(num)
        return sorted(result)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.sequentialDigits(100, 300))  # [123,234]

assert sol.sequentialDigits(100, 300) == [123, 234]
assert sol.sequentialDigits(1000, 13000) == [1234, 2345, 3456, 4567, 5678, 6789, 12345]

assert sol.sequentialDigits(10, 99) == [12, 23, 34, 45, 56, 67, 78, 89]
assert sol.sequentialDigits(10, 10) == []
assert sol.sequentialDigits(98, 123) == [123]
assert sol.sequentialDigits(123456789, 123456789) == [123456789]
assert sol.sequentialDigits(1_000_000_000, 1_000_000_000) == []
assert sol.sequentialDigits(10, 1_000_000_000) == [
    12,
    23,
    34,
    45,
    56,
    67,
    78,
    89,
    123,
    234,
    345,
    456,
    567,
    678,
    789,
    1234,
    2345,
    3456,
    4567,
    5678,
    6789,
    12345,
    23456,
    34567,
    45678,
    56789,
    123456,
    234567,
    345678,
    456789,
    1234567,
    2345678,
    3456789,
    12345678,
    23456789,
    123456789,
]
assert sol.sequentialDigits(500, 600) == [567]
assert sol.sequentialDigits(789, 1234) == [789, 1234]
assert sol.sequentialDigits(2345, 6789) == [2345, 3456, 4567, 5678, 6789]
assert sol.sequentialDigits(123, 123) == [123]
assert sol.sequentialDigits(987654321, 987654321) == []
assert sol.sequentialDigits(100, 1000) == [123, 234, 345, 456, 567, 678, 789]
